thesis: Art may make unpleasant experience intelligible and preserve conflict without guaranteeing moral benefit or requiring agreeable beauty.

ideas.statement: Subject, representation and effects differ; formal mastery can serve objectionable projects, and neither shock nor institutional prestige guarantees quality.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Distancing–Embracing is a model rather than universal benefit; kitsch accusations and contempt for decoration can police status rather than reveal value.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Distancing–Embracing is a model rather than universal benefit; kitsch accusations and contempt for decoration can police status rather than reveal value.

audit.notes: Direct active-LLM all-unit analysis; distinct values and qualifications preserved.
